identity.name: Luminor Base Logo
identity.one_liner: Panerai's discontinued entry-level manual-wind Luminor, 44mm steel with the brand's vintage 'OP' logo dial, produced 2016-2018.

narrative.story: The Luminor Base Logo was Panerai's accessible manual-wind model, pairing the 44mm Luminor case with a simple three-hand dial carrying the brand's vintage Officine Panerai 'Up/Down' logo. Panerai discontinued PAM01000 in 2018, succeeding it with reference PAM01086.
narrative.collector_notes: As a hand-wound piece, check winding feel and power reserve against a known-good reference; verify the caseback engraving matches a genuine 2016-2018 production batch, since it has been out of catalog for several years.
